---
title: "Transpose Matrix"
description: "Transpose an editable numeric matrix with NumPy."
---

This coding playground receives a Gradio data frame as a NumPy array. Click **Run**, edit the matrix or choose an example, and submit to exchange its rows and columns.

```{python}
import numpy as np
import gradio as gr

def transpose(matrix):
    return matrix.T


demo = gr.Interface(
    transpose,
    gr.Dataframe(
        type="numpy",
        datatype="number",
        row_count=5,
        col_count=3,
        show_fullscreen_button=True
    ),
    "numpy",
    examples=[
        [np.zeros((3, 3)).tolist()],
        [np.ones((2, 2)).tolist()],
        [np.random.randint(0, 10, (3, 10)).tolist()],
    ],
    cache_examples=False
)

demo.launch()
```
